messages:
Ravi: urgent  shipment for PO 812345 (EU fulfillment) is stuck at customs in NL, carrier is refusing delivery until duties paid. Partner is asking Redwood to cover import duties so delivery can complete today.
AP-bot: Invoice flagged: IMPORT_CHARGE_DISPUTE. Carrier invoice INV-3321 for duties EUR 12,450 attached to shipment. PO 812345 references Incoterm: DAP (Delivered At Place) which means receiver pays duties.
Isabel: Partner (NordicSystems BV) says their sales team had verbal agreement for DDP for this first deployment to simplify onboarding. No paper trail. They want Redwood to pay duties this time and Redwood will deduct on next invoice.
CustomsBot: Customs holds require payment or formal BA (broker authorization). Documents missing: commercial invoice copy, EORI number for consignee, power of attorney for customs broker. Status: HOLD at Rotterdam terminal.
Ravi: PO excerpt:
```
PO: 812345
Amount: EUR 198,000
Incoterm: DAP (default)
Shipping: SEA
Destination: NL
Vendor: NordicSystems BV (merchant: nordic-dist)
```
Isabel: Sales says partner can issue a credit memo next month to reimburse Redwood, but finance needs formal agreement before we advance payment.
Ops: We could do a short-term advance to carrier using a customs payment vendor, but need approval from Tax + AP and a signed reimbursement agreement from partner. Risk: if partner defaults Redwood bears duty cost.
Tax: Duties may have VAT recovery implications; if Redwood pays, reclaim depends on import evidence and consignee registration (we need EORI/GST flags). Also need broker invoice to substantiate reclaim.
AP-bot: Created AP-TICKET-9601 for carrier prepay request. Status: pending-approvals.
Ravi: This is blocking go-live on the Dedicated HW cluster. If delivery delayed we miss customer demo on Friday. Sales pressure high.
Isabel: Partner contact @PartnerContact says they can sign a short reimbursement addendum (one page) acknowledging Redwood will prepay duties and partner will reimburse within 30 days via credit memo or bank transfer. They can sign today if legal drafts.
PartnerContact: Confirmed  we can sign today and provide EORI and broker POA. Please send addendum.
Tax: Draft addendum language suggestion: "Redwood may advance payment of import duties and associated broker fees for shipment related to PO 812345. Partner will reimburse Redwood within 30 days of Redwood invoice. Partner warrants accuracy of shipment value and indemnifies Redwood for any additional customs penalties or fines." Keep it short.
Ops: If approved, treasury can pay carrier immediately upon receipt of signed addendum and invoice from carrier. We should also require partner to provide EORI and broker POA before payment.
AP-bot: AP-TICKET-9601 status: awaiting-signed-addendum + carrier-invoice.
Ravi: Action items: Isabel to collect partner signature and EORI + POA; Tax to confirm reclaim steps; AP to prep payment flow and ticket; Ops to coordinate carrier release. Deadline: 4 hours. Jira: SUPPORT-3612 (customs-prepay).
Isabel: Got it  sending addendum to partner now.
AP-bot: Escalation created: ESC-1258 customs-prepay-urgent.
Tax: If partner provides EORI and broker POA we'll proceed with payment and start VAT reclaim documentation. Ensure carrier invoice shows duty breakdown.
Ravi: Thanks team  please post signed addendum here when received. If not received in 2 hours call partner escalation line. :telephone_receiver:
Ops: Carrier confirmed release ETA 1 hour after payment posts.
PartnerContact: Signed addendum uploaded at 14:22 and EORI/Broker POA attached. Sending bank confirmation for reimbursement.
AP-bot: AP-TICKET-9601 status: docs-received. Payment scheduled for immediate release pending treasury.
Ravi: Closing loop  will update SUPPORT-3612 when hardware delivered. :white_check_mark:
